meta.title: Our story | From Putney Bridge in 2000 to TenthMatrix
meta.description: How the business began in 2000 at Putney Bridge, London, as a tech talent company, became Workstation, moved to the Marlowes in Hemel Hempstead, and launched TenthMatrix for AI agents and software.

header.title: Our story
header.subtitle: From a tech talent business by the Thames to AI agents, AI tools and the software they run on.

intro.title: Where it all began
paragraphs: TenthMatrix began as Workstation, founded in 2000 at Putney Bridge, London, with a simple idea: connect good technology people with the businesses that need them. It was a tech talent business first. Matching the right people and tools to the right problem is still how we work.

Over the years the company moved, changed hands and changed shape: from talent to hardware and software, then to AI. In 2026 the software side became TenthMatrix. This page tells that story one milestone at a time.

entries.title: Founded at Putney Bridge, London
entries.description: Steve Gibson, Vivien Gibson and Nathan Mayatt start Workstation at Putney Bridge in London as a tech talent business, helping companies find the technology people they need.
entries.alt: Putney Bridge over the River Thames in London, with St Mary's Church on the far bank

entries.title: Growing the UK's largest talent database
entries.description: Step by step, and with the help of automation, the business grows into the largest talent database in the UK for digital creators, technology leaders and marketing services.

entries.title: A new home on the Marlowes
entries.description: Workstation moves to an office at the Marlowes in Hemel Hempstead, Hertfordshire.
entries.alt: Entrance to the Marlowes Shopping Centre in Hemel Hempstead

entries.title: Balinder Walia takes over as CTO
entries.description: Balinder Walia takes over the business as Chief Technology Officer, bringing a technologist's eye to everything Workstation does.

entries.title: A new CEO and a new direction
entries.description: Balinder Walia becomes CEO. Workstation grows into a supplier of hardware and software services, and starts building websites, AI chatbots and agents for clients.

entries.title: TenthMatrix is launched
entries.description: The software side is split out as TenthMatrix: AI agents, AI tools, AI applications and the products they run on, including Proxy10x, VPN10x, Vault10x and Registry10x. Workstation keeps the GPU workstations and hardware. Both are brands of Workstation Solutions Ltd.

entries.title: AI agents and AI-assisted software
entries.description: We design, build and run AI agents and generative AI applications for clients, and publish the engineering behind them on this site.
